**Why now:** Recent advances in LLM capabilities and adoption by major tech firms are driving new application development, making AI more accessible and embedded in daily tasks.

**Keywords:** `agent`, `rag`, `llm`, `workflow`, `copilot`

**Reference tickers/themes:** `MSFT`, `GOOGL`, `META`, `CRM`, `ADBE`
